_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S6 Silver Cross). Sourced 2026-07-05. Represents Silver Cross Reef 2, the current US Reef; Clek lists 'Reef, Reef 2'. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Silver Cross Reef 2 (covers Reef / Reef 2)

clekListed.clekRow: Silver Cross Reef, Reef 2 — Dune/Reef Car Seat Adapters

specs._weightNote: 26.5 lb chassis + seat combined (excl. bumper bar) per Silver Cross US. Component breakout elsewhere quoted as ~17.6 lb chassis + ~9.9 lb seat.
specs._dimsNote: Silver Cross US Reef 2: open L33 x W23.5 x H39-44 in; folded (seat on, self-standing) L19 x W23.5 x H29 in. Height range reflects adjustable handle.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (lie-flat seat / folding bassinet included, overnight-sleep approved)

safety.standards: ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 (US market). No specific standard is published on the Silver Cross US spec page; Silver Cross is UK-origin (EN 1888 in home market, not stated for US units). No named third-party certification (e.g. JPMA) published.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; lie-flat reversible seat; folding bassinet is overnight-sleep approved; one-hand self-standing fold.

specs.foldType: one-hand self-standing fold (folds with seat attached)
specs.tires: large lockable multi-terrain wheels, four-wheel suspension (foam-filled)

notes: Current US Reef is the Reef 2; Clek's row names 'Reef, Reef 2'. Full-size modular all-terrain system (heavier than the city goal at ~26.5 lb) — complements rather than replaces the light/compact objective. Clek Liing mounts via the shared Silver Cross Dune/Reef car seat adapters ($59.99, in stock). Best cited price $1,199.99 (multiple US retailers agree).
